name: tolue-concrete-rheology-pumpability
description: TOLUE engineering desktop platform for concrete rheology and pumpability analysis.

scripts.build:desktop: esbuild src/desktop/renderer/index.ts --bundle --platform=browser --format=iife --outfile=dist/desktop/renderer/index.js && esbuild src/desktop/main/electronPdfAdapter.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=dist/desktop/main/electronPdfAdapter.cjs && esbuild src/desktop/preload/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=dist/desktop/preload/index.cjs && esbuild src/desktop/main/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=dist/desktop/main/index.cjs
scripts.package:win: npm run build:desktop && npx --yes electron-builder@26.0.12 --win nsis --x64 --publish never
